item: Sakurai tea counter and Gen Yamamoto
TableCheck, Tabelog and OMAKASE accounts created with a working card
Site installed to Home Screen on both phones and logged in
Trip calendar subscribed on both phones; test one alert
Open the site once in airplane mode to confirm it works offline
Download a Google Maps offline area for central Tokyo
Data eSIM or pocket Wi-Fi sorted
Transit card in the phone wallet (confirm current Suica/PASMO options for your phone)
Entry and customs registration done (confirm current Japan arrival requirements for your passport)
Cash in yen — several kissaten and Kappabashi shops are cash-only
Physical passport on you for tax-free purchases over ¥5,500 (photos not accepted)
Space in checked luggage for knives — never carry-on
